_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Jig/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the front bottom cell, nearest the player who placed it; the jig runs south from it. A Harz plunger jig: the sieve compartment at the front, the plunger compartment behind. theta is the axle: the shaft turns with it and the plunger rises and falls once a turn (an eccentric in a yoke, the same either way the axle turns). Every service is on its own face, centred: the axle (powerCell/powerFace), the infeed chute (infeedCell/infeedFace, from above), the tailings and concentrate chutes (tailingsCell/tailingsFace, concentrateCell/concentrateFace, out to a chute beyond) and the ppex water pipe (waterCell/waterFace). buildStages: what each build stage adds, in order: the sieve, the drive and plunger, then services (the chutes and the water inlet); the hutch is the frame, placed. water and bed are what the machine holds while it works, in no stage. See the jig's README for the schema.

levels._comment: Heights in blocks: the weir's sill (the water's level), the sieve's top, the hutch's rim.

pipes._comment: The water inlet: ppex's straight pipe, soldered, one part per metal (the same elements); only the supplied metal's is drawn.

contents._comment: requires values for what the jig holds: water (its surface in each compartment) while its reservoir has water, the ore bed on the sieve while it works.

drive._comment: The plunger's strokes per turn of the axle (the eccentric is keyed on the shaft, which turns with the axle) and its stroke in blocks, either way the axle turns.
